newsitem.title: USA: IGEN stake raised by Tisch partnership.
newsitem.headline: IGEN stake raised by Tisch partnership.

text.p: Four Partners, an investment partnership controlled by the Tisch family, said Wednesday it raised its stake in IGEN International Inc to 8.6 percent or 1,288,200 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership said it bought 480,000 additional shares of IGEN between December 30 and January 3 at prices ranging from $4.75 to $5.25 a share.
The New York-based partnership previously held a 5.1 percent stake in IGEN, a Gaithersburg, Md.,-based maker of diagnostic systems.
